mapper.select: SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, status, version, description, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM matching_score_policy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY version DESC, policy_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, status, version, description, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM matching_score_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT policy_item_id AS policyItemId, policy_id AS policyId, score_group AS scoreGroup, element_code AS elementCode, display_name AS displayName, weight, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM matching_score_policy_item WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} AND active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY score_group, sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE matching_score_policy SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, h.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_name AS policyName, p.version, h.changed_by AS changedBy, u.email AS changedByEmail, u.nickname AS changedByNickname, CAST(h.before_json AS CHAR) AS beforeJson, CAST(h.after_json AS CHAR) AS afterJson, h.change_reason AS changeReason, h.created_at AS createdAt FROM matching_score_policy_history h JOIN matching_score_policy p ON p.policy_id = h.policy_id JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = h.changed_by ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
